name: Rosewood Phnom Penh
insider_take: Where ultra-luxury meets Cambodia's vibrant capital, offering unparalleled views of the Mekong and Tonle Sap rivers from the heart of Phnom Penh's diplomatic quarter.
whats_special: This stunning property is housed in a sleek 39-story tower that dominates Phnom Penh's skyline, making it the tallest building in Cambodia. The hotel's prime Vattanac Capital location puts you steps away from the Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda, while the rooftop bar offers 360-degree views of the convergence of two mighty rivers.
pro_tip: Book a river-view suite on floors 25+ for breathtaking sunrise views over the Mekong, and time your visit during the Water Festival (November) when traditional boat races fill the rivers below.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Iza restaurant showcases innovative Khmer cuisine with ingredients sourced from local markets, while the Sense spa features traditional Khmer healing treatments. Take the short walk to the nearby Central Market's Art Deco architecture and browse for authentic Cambodian silk and silver crafts.
pros: Ultra-luxury accommodations with Rosewood's signature residential-style service
Prime location in Phnom Penh's prestigious Vattanac Capital tower
Sophisticated dining venues featuring international and Khmer cuisine
Stunning panoramic city views from upper floors and rooftop areas
cons: Modern high-rise setting rather than traditional Cambodian architecture
